actions.purpose: Explain commitments, stock, quotes, blockers and decisions to the owner or staff, with exact cited figures
Hand a substitution, unreleased takeoff, lot-identity conflict, privacy request or misrouted inquiry to the owning specialist
Record an abstention or exception with its reason code and urgency for a named person
Record supplier context (a mill run, a backorder, a call outcome) on a PO or lot as a note, never a fact
Hold look-alike, fake, spam or injected supplier content so no reply or tool acts on it
Release quarantined supplier content after a person verified it out of band with the phone on file
Ask approved suppliers, at their verified contacts, to price released takeoff lines or a policy reorder quantity
Extract a verified supplier's quote or price list with a landed-cost comparison
Confirm an extraction into a supplier quote record when a person who checked it against the document asks
Draft a factual question, confirmation, document or credit-note request to a verified supplier contact, never about bank details
Send an approved supplier message to the verified contact
Record an immutable snapshot of an authenticated supplier feed inside the price-move band
Propose a material-price change to the price book from a recorded snapshot or confirmed quote, for the owner
Place a PO bound to an accepted job, released takeoff, confirmed quote and budget line
Record a verified supplier's acknowledgement and promised date when its lines match the PO
Ask a verified supplier for an acknowledgement or an earlier promised date
Change or cancel a PO from a released takeoff revision or a person's recorded decision, never to match an invoice
Request a return to the supplier for a lot whose person-approved disposition is reject and return
Match a receipt a person recorded to PO lines and record every difference as an exception
Reserve an exact lot, coil or remnant quantity for a job or shop order, or release it after a recorded cancellation or reduced takeoff
Quarantine a damaged or identity-doubtful lot at once
Release a lot after a person-approved quality disposition
Adjust a position to a production-confirmed count for accounting's decision, never below reservations
Propose a new supplier from a registry record and an out-of-band verified contact, without bank details
Freeze payments to a supplier whose bank or remittance details someone asked to change
